''See also: [[Luminian Knights Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Luminian]] Knights are a disciplined military force belonging to the [[Luminian Order]], one of the ten pillars of [[The Empire|the Empire]]. Known for their silver armor decorated with a [[White Sun]] motif, these warriors are highly regarded for their legendary defensive capabilities, which are bolstered by centuries of [[Intent]]. They typically operate alongside [[Pilgrims]]—members of the [[Order]] distinguished by white clothing and silver medallions—and are capable of providing auxiliary support in combat. While the [[Order]] was once associated with war, they have transitioned into preaching peace and are recognized for their organizational structure. Their headquarters, [[Hightower]], is a famous fortified location situated near the Capital that possesses a protective aura due to long-standing devotion. The [[Order]] maintains complex political relationships, acting as allies to certain groups while remaining responsible for various internal security issues. Their members are subject to strict regulations and oaths, and they serve as a significant presence in both security and combat roles throughout [[The Empire|the Empire]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Acting as the representatives of the [[Unknown God]], the [[Luminian]] Knights are bound by a sacred oath to prioritize the lives of innocents over their own. These warriors bring death to any servants of the void and show no mercy or compassion toward the [[Elders]]. Their presence is further distinguished by their legendary armor, which has gained its renown through centuries of [[Intent]].}}
